correctness.rationale: Absolute Gaussian convergence justifies the Taylor and Poisson steps. Oddness yields zero constant and even energy with quartic remainder. The shifted Poisson identity gives exact X(a)=Y(1/(2a)); dominant Gaussian terms provide all four leading asymptotics and the two local area coefficients. The accompanying executed checker independently tested the formulas on finite parameter grids but is not used as proof.

value.rationale: This is a full quantitative curvature classification for every lattice aspect ratio on a canonical previously known nonframe hyperbola. The exact Fourier-duality exchange, sharp exponentially small curvature direction, and local sublevel area coefficient measure the severity and anisotropy of the spectral singularity, rather than merely restating that a frame fails. These coefficients are natural for local fiber conditioning and thresholding, and the two extreme limits are not routine reformulations of rank deficiency. No global frame claim or noise-stability theorem is inferred.
